== Acquisition ==
* Talking to [[Kelvei, the Legendary Observer]] after completing [[Ad Infinitum II: Upper Bound]].
** The item can be acquired only if the [[Ad Infinitum III: Unbound]] collection hasn't been unlocked and if the item is not in inventory.

== Notes ==
* Multiple copies can be obtained.
* You must double-click (consume) it in order to unlock the collection.
